description: File a report on a vacancy that looks fake, spam, a scam, irrelevant, or that never answers. It goes to freehire's moderators, who review it by hand; it does not hide the job or change the user's own board. Only report when the user asks for it, or after you have told them what you will send and they agreed. One open report per job per user.

details.description: What is wrong, in the user's words. Optional but helps the moderator.

reason.description: no_response: applicants never hear back. not_relevant: not a real job for this board. spam: repeated or promotional. fraud: scam or fake employer. other.

name: report_job
title: Report a job posting
